summary: Checkout p99 latency degraded to several seconds with timeout errors
resolution: Pool was sized at 60 against measured concurrency of 95. Raised to 150.

summary: Checkout latency climbing through the afternoon, callers timing out
resolution: A reporting join lost its index during a schema migration. Index rebuilt.

summary: Gateway slow and erroring, no change on our side
resolution: Token provider had a regional outage. We failed open after 20 minutes.

summary: Sync operations intermittently slow and timing out
resolution: A batch reconciliation job held connections open for the whole run.

summary: Report endpoints slow, no deploy, error rate slightly up
resolution: Row growth pushed a sequential scan past the statement timeout.

summary: Large share of sends failing at the delivery provider
resolution: We crossed the documented per-minute quota after a concurrency change.

summary: Delivery failures at the provider with no status page update
resolution: Provider was in a partial outage they acknowledged four hours later.

summary: Intermittent authentication failures, users logged out unexpectedly
resolution: Time sync daemon had died on three of eleven hosts; offset reached 41s.

summary: Authentication failing broadly, unclear whether network or provider
resolution: A DNS record was edited during a migration and cached negatively.

summary: Storage provider rejecting a large share of writes
resolution: Provisioned capacity units were fully consumed; quota raised.

summary: Indexer throughput down and latency up over several hours
resolution: A caching layer added in the previous release retained every document.

summary: Authorisation calls failing in volume at the processor
resolution: Processor incident; our retry storm extended it. We added a circuit breaker.
